_comment: The fee a trade pays on the bonding curve, which is where the prize comes
Robinhood Chain, Pons v2. Read live from the factory
0x7ed598bcef8bd9edd8c97a195c6d13f40801ec7e and from a captured fee sweep,
factory owner can change base_fee_bps and protocol_share_bps for FUTURE
launches; a launched curve keeps what it snapshotted, so this fixture is
dated like every other figure on this site.
There is no market-cap ladder here the way pump.fun had one. A Pons v2
curve charges one flat rate: a 100 bps base fee, split 70/30 between the
creator and the protocol, plus a creator tax the launcher sets once at
launch (0 to 1,000 bps, ceiling per factory maxCreatorTaxBps()), paid to
the creator in full. ADR 0013 constraint 3 (unchanged by ADR 0029) makes
all of the creator's share the weekly prize.
